`r descr_models("rand_forest", "orf")`

## Tuning Parameters

```{r orf-param-info, echo=FALSE}
defaults <-
  tibble::tibble(
    parsnip = c(
      "mtry", "trees", "min_n", "sample.fraction", "honesty",
      "honesty.fraction"
    ),
    default = c(
      "see below", "see below", "see below", "see below", "TRUE",
      "see below"
    )
  )

param <-
  rand_forest(
    mtry = integer(0),
    trees = integer(0),
    min_n = integer(0)
  ) |>
  set_engine(
    "orf",
    sample.fraction = double(0),
    honesty = logical(0),
    honesty.fraction = double(0)
  ) |>
  set_mode("classification") |>
  make_parameter_list(defaults)
```

This model has `r nrow(param)` tuning parameters:

```{r, orf-param-list, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
param$item
```

`mtry` and `min_n` depend on the data dimensions. `sample.fraction`,
`honesty`, and `honesty.fraction` are engine-specific arguments that can be
passed via [set_engine()] and are registered as tunable parameters by
`ordered`.

## Translation from parsnip to the original package

`r uses_extension("rand_forest", "orf", "classification")`

```{r orf-cls}
library(ordered)

rand_forest(
  mtry = integer(1),
  trees = integer(1),
  min_n = integer(1)
) |>
  set_engine(
    "orf",
    sample.fraction = 0.7,
    honesty = TRUE,
    honesty.fraction = 0.4
  ) |>
  set_mode("classification") |>
  translate()
```
